description: The Red Haven Live is a live music and food venue located in Orange Beach, Alabama. The venue features live entertainment from various bands and artists, with a menu that has been expanded significantly. The venue celebrated its one-month anniversary with positive reviews and is actively booking artists and bands for upcoming events.
atmosphere: Live music venue with food service, country group entertainment focus

raw_text_content: The Red Haven Live - Orange Beach, Alabama venue featuring live music and food service. Hours: Thursday 11am-Midnight, Friday 11am-Midnight, Saturday 11am-Midnight, Sunday 11am-Till. One-month anniversary celebration with expanded menu and positive reviews. Live entertainment from various bands and artists. Merchandise available including branded t-shirts. Contact: booking@theredhavenlive.com. Featured in AL.com article about new Orange Beach venues.
